title: Flow of Reasoning: Training LLMs for Divergent Reasoning with Minimal Examples
one_line: 将LLM推理建模为DAG上的GFlowNet flow，用log-variance损失实现少样本训练
innovations: 将多步推理形式化为DAG结构上的GFlowNet flow，使前向策略P_F按reward R(s_n) ∝ Z(s_0)P_F(τ)采样
采用log-variance损失LV(τ)=(Φ(τ)-EΦ)^2替代难学的log Z，Φ(τ)=log R+Σlog P_B-Σlog P_F
结合on-policy tempering、off-policy replay buffer与local search做高效探索，在少样本(15例/步)下训练
method_framework: 将推理状态s_t视为DAG节点，前向策略P_F(s_t|s_{t-1},g)由LLM给出，反向策略P_B由预训练LLM的log-likelihood导出；terminal reward R=w·I(success)+λΣ(-1/log P_LLM(a_t|s_{t-1},g))；最小化batch内Φ(τ)的方差以满足flow matching；训练时混合on-policy与off-policy轨迹。
experiment_framework: BlocksWorld(2/4/6步)与Game of 24；基座Llama-3-8B；基线CoT/ToT/GoT/XoT/RAP/OpenAI-O1-mini/O1-preview/SFT/SFT+PPO/SFT+GFN-CoT；指标Acc(n次采样至少一次正确)、Diversity(语义不同正确解数)、Creativity(独有的正确解比例)、Runtime。
takeaways: BlocksWorld 6步上FOR达78.44% Acc、Diversity 1.33、Creativity 9.52%，优于SFT/PPO/GFN-CoT，接近O1-mini(93.93%)且推理速度快30倍
Game of 24上FOR Acc 48% vs SFT 29%、Creativity 29.15%，而O1-mini达94%但无多样性
仅用15个训练示例/步数即超过多数prompting与SFT基线
weaknesses: Game of 24上FOR Acc(48%)显著低于OpenAI-O1-mini(94%)，说明在单路径精度上仍落后于大规模RL模型
reward设计依赖LLM log-likelihood做intermediate reward，在长链推理中累积偏差未分析
仅在BlocksWorld与Game of 24两个规则化任务验证，数学/代码等开放推理任务的多样性增益未展示
